token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API Key:
    1. Log in to your Aidbase dashboard.
    2. Navigate to **Settings** in the sidebar.
    3. Click on the **API** section.
    4. Generate and copy your new API Key.

add_video.label: Add Video
add_video.description: Adds a YouTube video URL as knowledge to the Aidbase knowledge base.

video_url.label: YouTube Video URL
video_url.description: The URL of the YouTube video to add as a knowledge source.

add_website.label: Add Website
add_website.description: Adds a website URL as a knowledge source for Aidbase.

website_url.label: Website URL
website_url.description: The URL of the website to add as a knowledge source (e.g., https://www.example.com).

add_faq_item.label: Add FAQ Item
add_faq_item.description: Adds a new question/answer item to an existing FAQ; supports categories.

faq_id.label: FAQ
faq_id.description: Select the FAQ to which the item will be added.

source_url.label: Source URL
source_url.description: An optional URL for the source of the information.

categories.label: Categories
categories.description: A list of category names. New categories will be created if they do not exist.

create_faq.label: Create FAQ
create_faq.description: Creates a new FAQ entry with title and description.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the new FAQ knowledge base.

description.label: Description
description.description: An optional description for the FAQ.

create_chatbot_reply.label: Create Chatbot Reply
create_chatbot_reply.description: Generates an AI chatbot reply given a message and optional session context.

chatbot_id.label: Chatbot
chatbot_id.description: Select the chatbot that will generate the reply.

message.label: Message
message.description: The message or question to send to the chatbot.

session_id.label: Session ID
session_id.description: An optional session ID to maintain conversation context. If omitted, a new conversation will start.

start_training.label: Start Training
start_training.description: Starts a training job on an existing knowledge base item (FAQ, website, video, etc.).

knowledge_id.label: Knowledge Item
knowledge_id.description: Select the knowledge item to train.
